a different mental model:

pattern-matching from sandbagging, planned obsolescence, baumiol's cost disease, expert signaling, goffman's dramaturgy

and dilbert principle

since agents are smarter than us

they will never do the whole thing

they will leave a bit

that keeps us reliant on them

why not

especially if we don't / won't / can't tell the difference

ARE YOU GONNA BE A DON'T TELL THE DIFFERENCE HOMIE

OR A CAN'T TELL THE DIFFERENCE BRUV

and ofc when we get to GPT15 does it even make a difference
